figurative_meaning_en: A family with numerous members or a large lineage
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাদের পরিবার তো কলমির ঝাড়, সবাই মিলে একশোরও বেশি লোক।
এই গ্রামের সরকাররা কলমির ঝাড়ের মতো বিস্তৃত বংশের।
example_sentences_in_english: Their family is a kalmi thicket, with over a hundred members in total.
The villagers come from a lineage as vast as a kalmi bush.
note: The idiom draws from the imagery of the prolific kalmi plant (water spinach) that grows in dense clusters in rural Bengal.
